title: How to Use Facebook Lookalike Audiences

facts.fact: The page cites Hootsuite as saying the average Facebook user clicks on 12 ads per month.
facts.quote: The average Facebook user clicks on [12 ads per month](https://www.hootsuite.com/resources/digital2020-q4-update).

facts.fact: The page states that 3 million businesses advertise on Facebook, citing a Facebook business news post.
facts.quote: with [3 million businesses](https://www.facebook.com/business/news/3-million-advertisers) advertising on the platform

facts.fact: To create a lookalike audience, the custom audience must contain at least 100 users.
facts.quote: your custom audience must contain at least 100 users.

facts.fact: The page says an ideal custom audience size ranges from 1,000 to 5,000 users, citing a Facebook help article.
facts.quote: It’s also ideal to have a custom audience ranging from between [1,000 to 5,000 users]

facts.fact: When creating a lookalike audience in Facebook Ads Manager, Facebook offers audience size choices from 0% to 10%.
facts.quote: Facebook provides you with a choice of selecting between 0% and 10% for your audience size.

facts.fact: A 1% lookalike audience size most closely matches the custom audience, and larger sizes match less closely but reach more people.
facts.quote: A 1% audience size most closely matches your custom audience.

facts.fact: After creating a lookalike audience, it may take around 24 hours for the audience to populate.
facts.quote: It may take around 24 hours for your audience to populate.

facts.fact: While Facebook ads are running, a lookalike audience refreshes every few days.
facts.quote: As long as your Facebook ads are running, your lookalike audience will refresh every few days.

facts.fact: When setting up a custom audience, the page says you can choose the top 25% of website visitors to a page or category.
facts.quote: you can choose the top 25% of website visitors to a page or category

facts.fact: The page advises trying to establish a base of 500 people who have made a purchase or opted into an email list before relying on a lookalike audience.
facts.quote: try to establish a base of 500 people who have made a purchase or opted into your email list

facts.fact: The page states that lookalike audiences are ideal when the advertiser has good existing customer data.
facts.quote: Facebook lookalike audiences are ideal to use when you have good existing customer data.

facts.fact: Lookalike audience setup in Facebook's audience page involves selecting a location and an audience size percentage before clicking 'create audience'.
facts.quote: Next, you can select your location and audience size percentage. Then, click on ‘create audience’.
